title: Sean Payton: We have to find a way to play better earlier

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean Payton: We have to find a way to play better earlier
sources.description: The Broncos were down 16-0 against the Rams at halftime on Sunday night, but they put up 30 points in the final 30 minutes to close out the game with their second straight win.
